name: Wo de Lei Tuo Wuyu
source:
Over four hundred years ago, three sages claimed the pitch-black sacred lake in the Mokegawa region as their own. They made a pact to each take exclusive control of the lake at different times—dawn, noon, and dusk.
The lake’s spirits, inspired by the sages’ wisdom, found a way to purify the dark waters.
But the three sages grew to dislike the now monotonous lake and eventually left, going their separate ways.
Later, to end a war, they set aside their differences and established M University by the lake, nurturing talent and working to rebuild the world.

Over four hundred years later, M-City, built around M University, has become a global leader in technological advancement.
Today, M-City is hosting its annual Open Day, but this year’s event seems far from peaceful…
A research scientist, a literature student, an astronomy student, a chemical company employee, a school staff member, a communications company director, a game programmer, an out-of-town dance student, a wealthy heiress, and an intern reporter all find their daily lives taking an unexpected turn.
On the eve of upheaval, the winds of change blow fiercely.
Their quiet lives are disrupted as a series of sudden events drags them into a sinister conspiracy targeting M-City.
These ten ordinary individuals, who had no prior connection, are now inexplicably linked. Their choices will determine the fate of all of M-City…

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1185530/My_Wet_Leto_Comic/]steam[/url]]
translation:
400多年前，三位贤者一同占据了萌川地区那片漆黑的神湖，约定分别独占湖泊的清晨、正午与傍晚。
湖中精灵从贤者的智慧中得到启发，找到了净化黑暗湖水的方法。
然而，三位贤者却逐渐厌倦了这片变得单调的湖泊，最终离去，各奔东西。
后来，为了结束战争，他们放下分歧，在湖畔建立了M大学，培养人才，重建世界。

400多年后，围绕M大学发展而成的M-City，已成为引领全球科技进步的城市。
今天，M-City照常举办一年一度的开放日，但今年似乎并不平静……
实验研究员、文学社学生、天文社学生、化工公司职员、学校职员、通信公司主任、游戏程序员、从外地而来的舞蹈女学生、富家千金，以及实习记者，都发现自己的日常生活发生了意想不到的变化。
剧变前夕，风起满楼。
宁静的生活被打破，一连串突发事件，将他们卷入了一场针对M-City的邪恶阴谋。
十名原本毫无关联的普通人，就这样阴差阳错地联系在一起。他们的选择，将决定整座M-City的命运……
